title: App size, install conversion, and what the store shows before the download

videos.script:
Before anybody uses the planner, they decide to download it. {{decide}} That decision happens on the store page, in a few seconds, and one of the things they read there is the size.

Size matters more than developers expect. {{size}} On a phone with little space left, on a prepaid data plan, a large download is a reason not to bother. And later, when space runs out, the largest rarely used app is the first one deleted.

Today you measure what a phone actually downloads. {{measure}} The same app bundle, cut by bundletool for each screen density, and the single universal file a phone would get without it.

Then the page itself. {{page}} The share of visitors who install is a number you can test, and you will see how many visitors it takes before a difference means anything.
